name: Night Raids
description: At nightfall, by chance, waves of Vukah gather outside a base where players are and march on its flame altar, at the players' level. A warning first, the raiders left on screen, a reward when you repel them; survivors flee at dawn. Installed switched off; once on, it is still off in every world until you switch it on there (raids.world on). Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing.

settings.label: Raids in the world you are in
settings.help: Kept with each world; every world starts off. Switch it while that world is loaded (or type raids.world on).

settings.label: Raids come at (hour)
settings.help: Rolled once per night, when the clock passes this hour.

settings.label: Raiders per wave
settings.help: At most 24 are alive at once.

settings.label: Seconds between waves
settings.help: Sooner when every raider of a wave is dead.

options.label: Easy: 5 levels below the strongest player at the base

settings.label: Boss wave
settings.help: The last wave brings a Vukah brawler, a mini-boss with a boss bar.

settings.label: My own templates
settings.help: Template GUIDs separated by commas. Untested ones may spawn asleep.

options.label: The one with the most players
Any base with players, at random

settings.label: Base radius (m)
settings.help: Around the flame altar: players inside are at the base; raiders gather 5-25 m beyond it (40-60 m from the altar at least), never inside.

options.label: Runes and furs, one each per raider slain
Runes, furs and a rare weapon at your level
